## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request contains one focused change.
- [ ] I ran `npm ci` after changing dependencies.
- [ ] I ran `npm run verify` successfully.
- [ ] I tested the relevant loading, error, empty, and accessibility states.
- [ ] I verified Android and iOS when native code or dependencies changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation or an ADR when a contract or architecture changed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, signing files, sensitive logs, or generated build files.
